doc_locator: Lei n.º 18/24 (OGE 2025), DR I Série n.º 247 de 30-12-2024, Resumo Da Receita Por Fonte De Recurso, p. 13944 (PDF p. 164); Dotação Orçamental Por Órgão, pp. 13969-14414
notes: The volume prints its financing split only for the whole budget (external financing 7,090,024,279,128 of 34,633,790,087,312, 20.47%). No organ, programme or project table prints a source column, so no digital line can be placed on the external side and the share is origin inferred. The national broadband network and the data-centre and cloud platform lines are the likeliest to carry external loans; the volume does not say.
